candidates.title: The Dry Cave With Wet Footprints
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered wet footprints appeared in a cave that had no visible stream before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the entrance for rainwater but the ground was dry; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized condensation from a cold overhead fissure dripped onto a narrow ledge; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they marked the slippery ledge and redirected visitors along a safe path, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

Fox examined the evidence and realized a nearby branch pressed against the chimes in strong gusts; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they pruned the obstructing branch and tested the chimes in the wind, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Ferry Rope That Tightened
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the ferry mooring rope tightened dangerously at low tide before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they loosened the knot but the strain returned; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the rope ran beneath a floating log that shifted as the tide dropped; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they freed the rope from the log and secured it along a clear route, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
